Lou Rawls – Live!

Label: Capitol Records
Catalog Number: T-2459
Format: Vinyl, LP, Album
Country: USA
Released: 1966

Classic live performance from Lou Rawls featuring his signature blues, soul, and jazz vocals. Includes standout performances of "Stormy Monday," "Tobacco Road," "St. James Infirmary," and "Goin' to Chicago Blues."

Track Listing

Side One

  • Stormy Monday
  • Southside Blues (Monologue)
  • Tobacco Road
  • St. James Infirmary
  • The Shadow of Your Smile
  • I'd Rather Drink Muddy Water

Side Two

  • Goin' to Chicago Blues
  • In the Evening When the Sun Goes Down
  • The Girl from Ipanema
  • I Got It Bad and That Ain't Good
  • Street Corner Hustler's Blues (Monologue)
  • World of Trouble
